description_en: Queries the cloud service configurations under a Basic Edition transit router by calling the DescribeRouteServicesInCen operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeRouteServicesInCen接口查询基础版转发路由器下的云服务配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun cbn describe-route-services-in-cen --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --cen-id cen-pfa6ugf3xl0qsd0000 --host 100.118.28.0/24 --host-region-id cn-hangzhou --access-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-vpc-id vpc-bp1h8vbrbcgohcju50000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRouteServicesInCen

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。默认值为10，取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The service address of the cloud service.

You can enter a domain name, an IP address, or a CIDR block
parameters.help_zh:
云服务的服务地址。

支持输入域名、IP地址或IP地址段
parameters.name: host

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cloud service.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
云服务所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: host_region_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID from which the cloud service is accessed
parameters.name: access_region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPC-connected instance associated with the cloud service
parameters.name: host_vpc_id

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for paging
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数

RouteServiceEntry.description_en: The list of cloud service configurations

AccessRegionId.description_en: The region ID from which the cloud service is accessed

CenId.description_en: The Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance ID

Cidr.description_en: The list of service addresses of the cloud service
Cidr.description_zh: 云服务的服务地址列表

items.description_en:
The service address of the cloud service.

If the request parameter Host is an IP address or a CIDR block, Cidrs is the IP address or CIDR block.
If the request parameter Host is a domain name, Cidrs is the IP address resolved from the domain name
items.description_zh:
云服务的服务地址。

如果请求参数Host是IP地址或IP地址段，则Cidrs为IP地址或IP地址段。
如果请求参数Host是域名，则Cidrs为域名解析后的IP地址

Description.description_en: The description of the cloud service

Host.description_en: The service address of the cloud service

HostRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the cloud service

HostVpcId.description_en: The instance ID of the VPC-connected instance associated with the cloud service

Status.description_en:
The status of the cloud service. Valid values:

Creating: being created.
Active: active.
Deleting: being deleted
Status.description_zh:
云服务的状态。

Creating：创建中。
Active：可用。
Deleting：删除中
